author: Allyza
body:
I can't appeal with the appeal tab, so I'm putting it here.

I was banned for Hacking (No Fall, Kill Aura) (E)

It started because of a glitch. I was frozen by 0_n for some random reason, and then someone killed me. After I spawned, I thought that it was just a glitch (since you aren't supposed to die while frozen).  I also couldn't shoot with my bow or place blocks. Please unban me, I believe I was punished unfairly due to a glitch. As for the killaura, I really can't tell you anything except that I'm legit.

replies.body: I was lagging a bit during the first clip. I can't really explain what happened, because everything looked good on my screen.
